name: Tennis
description: A racket sport played individually against a single opponent or between two teams of two players.

name: Basketball
description: A team sport in which two teams, most commonly of five players each, oppose one another on a rectangular court.

name: Soccer (Football)
description: A team sport played with a spherical ball between two teams of 11 players.

name: Volleyball
description: A team sport in which two teams of six players are separated by a net.

name: Table Tennis
description: A sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.

name: Badminton
description: A racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.

name: Baseball
description: A bat-and-ball game played between two opposing teams who take turns batting and fielding.

name: Cricket
description: A bat-and-ball game played between two teams of eleven players on a field at the centre of which is a 22-yard pitch.

name: American Football
description: A gridiron football game played by two teams of eleven players on a rectangular field with goalposts at each end.

name: Rugby Union
description: A close-contact team sport that originated in England in the first half of the 19th century.

name: Ice Hockey
description: A contact team sport played on ice, usually in a rink, in which two teams of skaters use their sticks to shoot a vulcanized rubber puck into their opponent's net to score goals.

name: Field Hockey
description: A widely played team sport of the hockey family, where players use sticks to hit a round, hard, plastic ball towards a goal.

name: Golf
description: A club-and-ball sport in which players use various clubs to hit balls into a series of holes on a course in as few strokes as possible.

name: Boxing
description: A combat sport in which two people, usually wearing protective gloves and other protective equipment, throw punches at each other for a predetermined set of time in a boxing ring.

name: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
description: A full-contact combat sport that allows a wide variety of fighting techniques and skills from a mixture of other combat sports to be used in competition.

name: Wrestling
description: A combat sport involving grappling type techniques such as clinch fighting, throws and takedowns, joint locks, pins and other grappling holds.

name: Swimming
description: An individual or team racing sport that requires the use of one's entire body to move through water.

name: Athletics (Track and Field)
description: A collection of sports events that involve competitive running, jumping, throwing, and walking.

name: Gymnastics
description: A sport that includes physical exercises requiring balance, strength, flexibility, agility, coordination, dedication and endurance.

name: Cycling
description: The use of bicycles for transport, recreation, exercise or sport.

name: Pickleball
description: A paddleball sport that combines elements of badminton, table tennis, and tennis.

name: Squash
description: A racket and ball sport played by two or four players in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.

name: Padel
description: A racket sport of Mexican origin, typically played in doubles on an enclosed court a third the size of a tennis court.

name: Bowling
description: A target sport and recreational activity in which a player rolls a ball toward pins or another target.

name: Darts
description: A sport in which small missiles are thrown at a circular dartboard fixed to a wall.

name: Snooker
description: A cue sport played on a rectangular billiard table covered with a green cloth called baize, with pockets at each of the four corners and in the middle of each long side.

name: Pool (Billiards)
description: A classification of cue sports played on a table with six pockets along the rails, into which balls are hit.

name: Water Polo
description: A competitive team sport played in water between two teams of seven players each.

name: Handball
description: A team sport in which two teams of seven players each pass a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the other team.

name: Lacrosse
description: A team sport played with a lacrosse stick and a lacrosse ball.

name: Netball
description: A ball sport played by two teams of seven players, derived from early versions of basketball.

name: Softball
description: A game similar to baseball played with a larger ball on a smaller field and with only underhand pitches allowed.

name: Surfing
description: A surface water sport in which an individual, a surfer, uses a board to ride on the forward section, or face, of a moving wave of water.

name: Skateboarding
description: An action sport that involves riding and performing tricks using a skateboard.

name: Snowboarding
description: A winter sport that involves descending a snow-covered slope while standing on a snowboard attached to a rider's feet.

name: Skiing
description: A recreation, sport and mode of transport that involves moving over snow by the use of a pair of long, flat runners called skis attached or bound to shoes or boots.

name: Rowing
description: The sport of racing boats using oars.

name: Sailing
description: The employment of wind power to propel a craft over water, ice or land.

name: Equestrian
description: Horse riding, including disciplines such as dressage, eventing, and show jumping.

name: Fencing
description: A group of three related combat sports using bladed weapons: the foil, the épée, and the sabre.

name: Judo
description: An unarmed modern Japanese martial art and Olympic sport.

name: Taekwondo
description: A Korean martial art, characterized by its emphasis on head-height kicks, jumping and spinning kicks, and fast kicking techniques.

name: Karate
description: A martial art developed in the Ryukyu Kingdom, characterized by punching, kicking, knee strikes, elbow strikes and open-hand techniques.

name: Weightlifting
description: A sport in which athletes compete in lifting a barbell loaded with weight plates from the ground to overhead.

name: Powerlifting
description: A strength sport that consists of three attempts at maximal weight on three lifts: squat, bench press, and deadlift.

name: Archery
description: The sport, practice, or skill of using a bow to shoot arrows.

name: Shooting
description: A competitive sport involving tests of proficiency with firearms or other projectile weapons.

name: Triathlon
description: An endurance multisport race consisting of swimming, cycling, and running over various distances.

name: Ultimate Frisbee
description: A non-contact team sport played with a flying disc.

name: Spikeball
description: A roundnet sport played by two teams of two players, involving hitting a ball off a circular net.

name: Kabaddi
description: A contact team sport played between two teams of seven players, originating in ancient India.

name: Sepak Takraw
description: A sport native to Southeast Asia, resembling volleyball but using a rattan ball and allowing players to use their feet, knees, chest, and head.

name: Bocce
description: A ball sport belonging to the boules family, played on a natural soil and asphalt court.

name: Croquet
description: A sport that involves hitting wooden or plastic balls with a mallet through hoops embedded in a grass playing court.

name: Polo
description: A horseback mounted team sport played with wooden mallets and a small plastic or wooden ball.
